## Why This Is Asked
Tests implementation of online PCA under streaming constraints, drift, and latency budgets. Requires concrete handling of missing data, component updates, and interpretable alerts.

- Incremental/Streaming PCA for non-stationary data
- Online imputation strategies and latency trade-offs

```python
# Pseudocode: incremental PCA with online imputer
from sklearn.decomposition import IncrementalPCA

    pca.partial_fit(X)
    Y = pca.transform(X)
    update_dashboard(Y, pca.components_, pca.explained_variance_ratio_)
```

- Global vs per-tenant PCA with privacy budgets

## Code Example
```
# DP sketch (pseudo)
def dp_pca(X, eps):
    Xc = clip(X, [-C, C], per_feature=True)
    mu = dp_mean(Xc, eps/2)
    sigma = dp_std(Xc, eps/2)
    Xn = (Xc - mu)/sigma
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Xn, full_matrices=False)
    return Xn @ Vt[:6].T
```
